title: Mutual annual-fees cap
clauseBefore: Vendor's aggregate liability shall not exceed fees paid in the prior three months.
clauseAfter: Except for Excluded Claims, each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed fees paid or payable in the prior twelve months.
comment: [Playbook] We made the cap mutual and aligned it to twelve months' fees, with standard carve-outs.

title: Fixed floor and carve-outs
clauseBefore: Provider's liability is limited to amounts paid under the applicable Order.
clauseAfter: Except for Excluded Claims, each party's liability is limited to the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000.
comment: [Playbook] We added a meaningful mutual cap and preserved uncapped treatment for excluded claims.

title: Vendor IP indemnity
clauseBefore: Customer shall indemnify Vendor for use of the Services.
clauseAfter: Vendor shall defend and indemnify Customer against third-party claims that the Services infringe intellectual property rights.
comment: [Playbook] We require the service provider to stand behind third-party IP claims arising from its services.

title: Data and misconduct indemnity
clauseBefore: No vendor indemnity was included.
clauseAfter: Vendor shall indemnify Customer for third-party claims arising from Vendor-caused data breaches, legal violations, gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
comment: [Playbook] We added protection for third-party claims caused by Vendor's data handling and misconduct.

title: Customer restriction removed
clauseBefore: Customer shall not develop or market any product competing with the Platform.
comment: [Playbook] We cannot restrict our business or internal development activities.

title: Sole supplier deleted
clauseBefore: Supplier shall be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosting services.
clauseAfter: Supplier will be a non-exclusive provider of hosting services.
comment: [Playbook] We retained flexibility to source services from other suppliers.

title: Customer-burdening MFN removed
clauseBefore: Customer shall offer Vendor terms no less favourable than those offered to any third party.
comment: [Playbook] We removed the open-ended obligation to match terms offered to third parties.

title: Narrow mutual non-solicit
clauseBefore: Customer shall not hire any Vendor employee for twenty-four months.
clauseAfter: Neither party shall directly solicit personnel involved in the Services for twelve months; general advertising and unsolicited approaches are excluded.
comment: [Playbook] We made this mutual, limited it to involved personnel and added customary carve-outs.

title: Thirty-day convenience exit
clauseBefore: Customer may not terminate an Order before the end of its term.
clauseAfter: Customer may terminate an Order for convenience on thirty days' notice and will receive a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.
comment: [Playbook] We added a practical convenience exit and refund for unused prepaid services.

title: Renewal notice shortened
clauseBefore: The Order renews automatically unless notice is given one hundred twenty days before expiry.
clauseAfter: The Order renews for successive twelve-month terms unless Customer gives thirty days' notice before expiry.
comment: [Playbook] We shortened the opt-out window and limited renewals to twelve months.

title: New York law and courts
clauseBefore: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the provider's home jurisdiction.
clauseAfter: This Agreement is governed by New York law, with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County.
comment: [Playbook] We moved governing law and venue to our accepted New York position.

title: Affiliate and successor carve-out
clauseBefore: Customer may not assign this Agreement without Vendor's consent.
clauseAfter: Customer may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets.
comment: [Playbook] We added customary affiliate and transaction successor rights.

title: Customer ownership and licence-back
clauseBefore: Vendor owns all Deliverables and Customer Data.
clauseAfter: Customer owns the Deliverables and Customer Data; Vendor retains pre-existing materials and grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable licence to embedded materials.
comment: [Playbook] We aligned ownership with the work and data we fund while preserving Vendor's background IP.

title: Affiliate and contractor use
clauseBefore: Licensor grants Customer a revocable, non-transferable licence for Customer's internal use.
clauseAfter: Licensor grants Customer and its affiliates and contractors a non-transferable licence, transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition.
comment: [Playbook] We extended operational use to affiliates and contractors and protected transaction continuity.

title: Annual off-site audit
clauseBefore: Vendor may inspect Customer's systems at any time.
clauseAfter: Vendor may conduct one off-site audit per calendar year on thirty days' notice through an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
comment: [Playbook] We limited audit frequency, notice and access to protect operations and sensitive systems.

title: Termination penalty capped
clauseBefore: Customer shall pay all remaining fees as liquidated damages upon early termination.
clauseAfter: Customer's sole early-termination fee shall not exceed three months' fees.
comment: [Playbook] We replaced the remaining-term penalty with the accepted three-month cap.

title: Ninety-day services warranty
clauseBefore: Services are provided as is.
clauseAfter: Vendor warrants for ninety days that the Services will be professional and workmanlike, with re-performance, repair, replacement or refund as the remedy.
comment: [Playbook] We added a meaningful performance warranty and remedy for non-conforming work.

title: Standard vendor coverage
clauseBefore: No insurance clause was included.
clauseAfter: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability, professional liability and cyber liability insurance and provide certificates on request.
comment: [Playbook] We added standard coverage appropriate for a vendor accessing our data and premises.

title: Take-or-pay removed
clauseBefore: Customer shall purchase the annual minimum volume and pay any shortfall.
clauseAfter: Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term.
comment: [Playbook] We removed the take-or-pay shortfall obligation.

title: Data return and transition
clauseBefore: Vendor may delete Customer Data immediately upon termination.
clauseAfter: Vendor will return Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, provide transition assistance for up to six months and then certify deletion.
comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly data return and transition period before deletion.
